reviews.title: Completely ruined a very important court document filed.
reviews.text: Typed out a 10 page document, worked over 22 hours straight on it, finish completely and sent it over to an attorney. Checked with them an hour later and they had sent back what they filed and it was an incomplete unfinished draft of everything I had worked on. Was a draft that I didn’t even have it was just a save from my completed document, apparently when I sent one email with the documents it went through fine but when I sent the other with a link, apparently there was not something updated through the Cloud that had the final version of the on it yet. It had extreme spelling errors and just incomplete all kinds of things that I had fixed in the final one. It was devastating and completely embarrassing because the finished project I cleaned everything up especially all the spelling and you can’t take that stuff back once you file it through the court it’s filed so that whole 22 hours straight of working on what I did, that actually physically & emotionally hurt.

reviews.title: Misleading app
reviews.text: I thought this was Microsoft office word editor but it’s a third party app.  Microsoft offers a premium office word editing week subscription for 7.99.  This app also offers a premium office word editing subscription for 7.99 a weekly until you cancel.  I used the service once thought I was downloading Microsoft office word editor instead it was this app.  I edited my document using one day of service which I was fine paying one charge of 7.99.  Then I notice more charges in ny Apple subscriptions.  I immediately cancel the subscription then get slapped with two more weeks of billing the day I cancel.    Can’t get ahold of anyone through their contact us links within the app it just keeps stating they will be back later for the last 3 weeks now and no one’s got back to me.  I’ve disputed the charges with Apple who denied the refunds and since the last two Billings came in the day I cancelled the subscription Apple now has my account restricted to download any new apps until I pay the bill.  Total scam and very misleading.  And no way to contact anyone with the app to dispute the charges!!
